report.description: A web application where residents apply for and track permits.
report.notes: Evaluated the public application flow and the account area. Draft example with invented results.
report.evaluation_methods: Automated scan of sampled pages, then keyboard and screen-reader testing of the main flows by a QA engineer.

1.1.1.remarks: Informational images have text alternatives. Three icon-only buttons on the payment page have no accessible name.

evidence.detail: Other images announced with equivalent text

1.2.1.remarks: The product has no prerecorded audio-only or video-only content, so there is nothing the criterion applies to.

evidence.detail: No audio-only or video-only content found in the sampled pages and states

2.1.1.remarks: All functions in the sampled flows work from the keyboard.

evidence.detail: Apply, pay and track flows completed without a mouse
No traps found, including in the payment dialog

1.4.3.remarks: Secondary text on the dashboard uses #8a8f98 on white (3.2:1), and the same gray is used for form hints across the product.

evidence.detail: Contrast failures on 9 of 12 sampled pages
